reviewer.role: Independent result reviewer; previously reviewed source and resources, did not run or implement the actual recovery attempt

scope: Consistency and evidence audit of failed local-recovery-01 result, updated recovery README, retained admission/attempt/readiness/containment, and executable offline SDK fixtures. Does not accept recovery, transaction execution, current state, canonical deployment finality or future diagnostic execution.

checks.name: admission-and-candidate-binding
checks.detail: Attempt admissionSha256 equals actual retained admission. All 48 admission file references and all 28 source-candidate03 files match their declared hashes. Source and resource references retain both reviewer identities and accepted verdicts on the exact source/proposal.

checks.name: failed-public-phase
checks.detail: committee-readiness.json exists and records success before the public Node call. The exact runner next constructs its plan in memory and launches public validation/preflight; no other subprocess occurs between retained committee readiness and that call. setup-failure records CalledProcessError and launcherAcknowledged false. No success projection or private-preparation record is retained; containment observations state the recovery base is absent. This supports FAILED_PUBLIC_PREFLIGHT and pre-private/pre-wallet scope.

checks.name: actual-failure-cause
checks.detail: Runner JavaScript catch discards the error and Python records only CalledProcessError. Import/validation/public-gate distinctions and the failing actual predicate cannot be recovered from that class. Attempt-result, RESULT.md and offline findings explicitly say the actual cause remains unknown. Synthetic schema failure is not mislabeled as an actual server defect.

checks.detail: All 12 committee sample files equal the retained sample array. Final READY sample has exact selected finalized/indexer hash and height, coherent committee/stored/sidechain/wall epochs, next committee, fresh timestamps and no rotation. Retained elapsed time is 40.29217926799902 seconds. This is committee readiness, not canonical-finality/current-state proof for the historical deployment.

checks.name: timer-and-containment-records
checks.detail: Attempt timer argv equals the armed record and reviewed fixed timer. Retained containment at +105.491 seconds reports absent/inactive launcher, zero PID, empty cgroup membership and all three containers exited with PID0, with private recovery base absent. Later timer-terminal record says inactive/not-found and does not invent a cancellation timestamp. Result contained=true is scoped to that retained actual observation; this reviewer did not rerun container/systemd queries.

checks.name: new-and-historical-charges
checks.detail: Public failure precedes new base, launcher/provider initialization and reservation creation in the exact runner. Zero new submission/DUST reservations and zero completed financial stages are consistent with that path and absent-base observation. One service attempt stays consumed with retryAllowed false. Prior three local reservation records retain three submissions and 900000000000003 SPECK; the prose correctly says reservations are not measured fees paid and other historical charges remain separate.

checks.name: compatible-offline-fixture
checks.detail: Exit0, PUBLIC_STATE_VERIFIED, fixtureClosed true, four actual SDK GraphQL requests and seven inert RPC calls. Exact installed provider digest matches 23a1883b796fbea037817ae0a7e0f5ed3c072a7d30974154a8de917893cd7f2f. Ephemeral 127.0.0.1 HTTP server returned synthetic compatible responses using retained public native bytes/state; no blockchain service or real network endpoint was accessed.

checks.name: schema-rejection-offline-fixture
checks.detail: Expected exit1, FAILED/IndexerQueryError with the synthetic diagnostic, fixtureClosed true, one GraphQL request and zero inert RPC calls. This demonstrates error transport in the synthetic case only.

checks.name: fixture-claims-and-retention
checks.detail: Inspected fixture source and both retained final outputs. Mode, SDK digest, query variables, native decode/equality behavior and server closure agree with the independently rerun outcomes. All three retained stderr logs are empty. Historical raw state and fees are supplied by the fixture; it does not check the real indexer schema, state, fees or actual cause. Exact-plan validation was read as retained offline evidence and was not independently re-executed.

checks.name: private-data-and-acceptance-language
checks.detail: Inspected result/readiness/containment/fixture outputs contain public identities, query shapes, status, timestamps and scoped diagnostics; no seed, role secret, storage password, private wallet state or signing key is emitted. Result, RESULT.md and updated deployment-recovery README leave recovery, loan calls, swap, Preview, full SP05 and PCD open, and claim no added canonical-finality/current-state confirmation.

limitations: Actual recovery services were not restarted and the operational runner was not executed by this reviewer. Retained containment/readiness observations were audited for consistency, not freshly replayed against systemd/Docker/chain.

Only the synthetic offline HTTP fixtures were executed; no wallet, original private files, private database, proof server or blockchain endpoint was accessed. Candidate/runtime sources and retained evidence were not edited.
The underlying actual public-preflight error remains unknown. Offline plan/SDK compatibility cannot identify it or establish real schema/state availability.
Actual source-candidate03 approval remains unchanged and does not establish successful recovery. This result review supplies no retry, resource allocation or diagnostic admission.
No absent future diagnostic files were reviewed. The stated next read-only diagnostic still requires its own exact source/resource assessment.
